description: EasyEDA Pro API skill for AI agents. Use when working with EasyEDA Pro EDA software, including PCB design, schematic editing, footprint/symbol management, and project operations. Supports live debuggi

en.tagline: Let AI agents work in a running EasyEDA Pro client
en.summary: EasyEDA API skill for AI agents. It gives reference docs for the EasyEDA Pro API and a WebSocket bridge that runs code in the open EasyEDA client. It also covers extension development and document source formats.
problem: AI agents often write EasyEDA API calls from memory and get them wrong. Common errors include missing await on Promise results, passing raw numbers where enum values are required, and mixing up coordinate units between PCB (1mil) and schematic (0.01inch).
With this skill, the agent looks up signatures in the references, runs the code in the live EasyEDA client through the bridge, and reads the returned result before it reports success.
fit: Scripting PCB or schematic edits in an open EasyEDA Pro project
Looking up API signatures and enums while writing an EasyEDA extension
Reading or generating EasyEDA document source files directly
unfit: Tasks that need no running EasyEDA client, since the bridge runs code only in a connected client
Work in EDA tools other than EasyEDA
steps: A Node.js bridge server starts in the background and takes the first free port from 49620 to 49629.
The run-api-gateway extension in EasyEDA Pro connects to the bridge over WebSocket.
The agent checks `/health` and `/eda-windows`, then selects the EasyEDA window to use.
The agent sends JavaScript to `POST /execute`, and the code runs in the client with the `eda` object.
Results come back only through `return` values, because console.log output is not captured.
The agent uses the API docs in `references/` and the source format docs in `format/` to write correct code.

zh.tagline: 让AI智能体操作正在运行的嘉立创EDA专业版
zh.summary: 面向AI智能体的嘉立创EDA API技能包。它提供专业版API参考文档，以及一个WebSocket桥接服务，可在已打开的嘉立创EDA客户端中执行代码。技能包同时涵盖扩展开发和文档源文件格式说明。
problem: AI智能体常凭记忆编写嘉立创EDA API调用，容易出错。常见问题包括：忘记对Promise结果使用await，在需要枚举值的地方传入裸数字，以及混淆PCB（1mil）与原理图（0.01inch）的坐标单位。
使用本技能后，智能体会先在参考文档中查找方法签名，再通过桥接服务在运行中的嘉立创EDA客户端里执行代码，并读取返回结果后再确认操作是否成功。
fit: 在已打开的嘉立创EDA专业版工程中，用脚本编辑PCB或原理图
编写嘉立创EDA扩展时，查询API签名和枚举值
直接读取或生成嘉立创EDA文档源文件
unfit: 不需要运行中的嘉立创EDA客户端的任务，因为桥接服务只能在已连接的客户端中执行代码
处理嘉立创EDA以外的其他EDA工具
steps: 一个Node.js桥接服务在后台启动，占用49620至49629中第一个可用端口。
嘉立创EDA专业版中的run-api-gateway扩展通过WebSocket连接到桥接服务。
智能体检查`/health`和`/eda-windows`，然后选定要使用的嘉立创EDA窗口。
智能体向`POST /execute`发送JavaScript代码，代码在客户端中借助`eda`对象运行。
执行结果只能通过`return`返回，console.log的输出不会被捕获。
智能体结合`references/`中的API文档和`format/`中的源文件格式文档编写正确的代码。
